items.desc: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦

Never keep an agent waiting. A free, open-source Mac menu bar app for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: see which session needs you and answer it with one keystroke.

AI-KIT is a practical starter kit for development: ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, DeepSeek, KIMI, and other coding agents. It provides reusable project context, rules for each stack, adaptive model routing, conservative installation and updates, testing and review workflows, security guidance, Docker and Kubernetes readiness, and clean project templates.
